game_title: Phrase Slicer – Supply Cache Camp Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Supply Cache Camp, a high supply cache: the summit pilot must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Phrase Slicer: Slice strings to cut messages into exactly the needed pieces.
theme: Frost Peaks – Supply Cache Camp: a high supply cache
core_gameplay_loop: In Supply Cache Camp, repeat each round: Slice strings to cut messages into exactly the needed pieces. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the phrase_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the summit beacon using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The summit beacon reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the summit beacon is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 3 (intro tier): Phrase Slicer
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how phrase_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice hawks in Supply Cache Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The summit beacon reached with actions_used <= 19.
